# Evaluation report (generated by `python -m src.evaluate`)

Held-out test seasons: 2324, 2425, 2526 (1140 matches). Primary model, chosen by tuning-season CV before scoring the test seasons: **blend_ordered_dixon_coles**.

Tuned parameters (walk-forward CV on 0001..2223): Elo {'k_factor': 25, 'home_advantage': 150, 'carryover': 1.0}, logistic {'C': 0.0003}, XGBoost {'max_depth': 3, 'learning_rate': 0.03, 'n_estimators': 100}, Dixon-Coles {'xi': 0.001}, blend weight on LR 0.8.
